name: Robstradomus
revisionLabel: Turn Expeditions into Long-Term Wizard Builds
description: A 2D single-player idle/incremental game inspired by the reference image’s visual style and gameplay feel. The player manages Robstradomus, a wizard who automatically fights monsters on a grid, earning XP from combat and map-specific resources based on his current map. Players use those gains to make the wizard stronger and progress through increasingly challenging grid maps.
